delegate.agentDesc: a file-editing agent without shell access

rules.instructions: Does the task give at least one concrete, explicit file path to create or modify?
rules.message: 任务未给出具体文件路径

rules.instructions: Does the task provide the definite content or exact edits to apply, so the agent need not draft wording itself nor explore to fill gaps?
Does the task require the agent to execute shell commands, run builds, tests, scripts, or restart or verify services?
rules.message: 任务要求执行 shell 命令/构建测试，delegate 无 bash 权限

rules.instructions: Does the task require the agent to investigate, explore, or look up information that is not contained in the task itself?
rules.message: 任务要求 agent 自行探索查资料

reviewer.agentDesc: a code-review agent (example: custom agent with a new rule id)

rules.instructions: Does the task ask the agent to change public API signatures or break backwards compatibility?

criteria.true: The task requires renaming, removing, or changing the signature of a public API, or changing behavior that existing callers depend on
criteria.false: The task only adds new code or changes internal implementation without affecting public APIs or observable behavior

rules.message: 任务可能破坏向后兼容，需人工确认
